title: Combining dependencies, approvals, MCP tools, and history on one Agent
description: This snippet shows how to pass dependencies, deferred approvals, an MCP toolset, and a history processor to a single Agent.

steps.description: Configure one Agent with deps_type=Deps, output_type=[str, DeferredToolRequests], MCPToolset for calendar_server.py, and ProcessHistory(keep_recent).
The comments note the remaining pieces for Exercise 1: registering save_deadline, skill_menu, and load_skill, and passing deps, message_history, and usage_limits at run time.
